prose: Dr. Moshe Daniel joins InnerVerse to teach us about Naturopathic Medicine! A true modern polymath, Moshe is versed in homeopathy, music, Hermeticism, and more. As an author and inventor, Dr. Daniel is a thought leader in the world of mind-body medicine, and has written multiple books, including The Revolution of Naturopathic Medicine.
ext: We dive into the mystery of the Mem-Shin-Heh, aka Moses/Messiah/Moshe, we discuss astrotheology and the historicity of mythos, learn more about homeopathy and how animals, starlight, and planetary energy can infuse remedies, and how to use these subtle but powerful tools to willfully shift and expand our consciousness.
